externalPlatformRouting.gsap: Use for advanced timeline, SVG path, scroll-like scrub, or MotionPath choreography when local CSS/WAAPI becomes too complex.
externalPlatformRouting.motion: Use for React app-like transitions, shared layout, gesture, and state-driven interaction.
externalPlatformRouting.animejs: Use for compact imperative timeline/stagger/SVG animation.
externalPlatformRouting.rive: Use only with authorized .riv assets and clear state-machine value.
externalPlatformRouting.lottie: Use only with authored or licensed .json/.lottie assets for compact icon/illustration loops.
externalPlatformRouting.threejs: Use for meaningful 3D scenes; verify nonblank canvas and framing.
